marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Lady and the tramp II : scamp's adventure

Synopsis :Share the wonder and enchantment in Lady and the Tramp II :Scamp's adventure, a heartwarming tale featuring a new generation of hilarious canine pals!Lady and Tramp's mischievous pup is always in the doghouse. Now, an itch for freedom is sending him on the ultimate adventure! Will Scamp choose the collar-free life with his new pals or embrace the pampered life he had at home?With nonstop laughs and paw-tapping songs, Lady and the Tramp II : Scamp's Adventure is Disney fun your whole family with love!
